topic: How does the 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna impact link budget calculations for GEO-LEO satellite links?
consensus_response: The 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna impacts link budget calculations by affecting transmit power requirements, which in turn influence coverage probability, system capacity, and spectral efficiency. A more efficient antenna reduces energy demands but may require careful consideration when incorporating Frequency-Selective Surface (FSS) technology to manage frequency-dependent losses, radiation patterns, and potential interference with other systems. Phased array technology can further optimize antenna performance by dynamically adjusting beamforming, but this adds significant complexity to the system design, requiring advanced signal processing capabilities and increased computational resources.
